verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data-export capability, such as exporting machine disks, snapshots, notebooks, or datasets in open formats. Root SSH access only lets a user copy files out manually, which is a user-side workaround. Snapshots are internal backups for reverting, and 'Cancel anytime' covers leaving but not exporting data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
